title: IPO以来最猛半年：宠物药企上调指引，美国增长11%能否延续？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We all know the numbers, though. I thought it was interesting. You told the analyst that when you go back over the last six months, uh, this was the best six months that you've had since the IPO. I am curious if you can kind of look forward and give me a sense here as
segments.zh: 我们都知道这些数字。我觉得有趣的是，你告诉分析师，回顾过去六个月，这是自IPO以来最好的六个月。我很好奇，你能不能展望一下，接下来六个月会是什么样子？

segments.en: what the next six months look like. Yeah, thank you remain. Yeah, it was a great, um, six months as I said, we beat and raised, uh,
segments.zh: 是的，谢谢你，雷明。是的，那是一个很棒的六个月，正如我所说，我们超出了预期并上调了指引。

segments.en: uh, grew, grew 10% on a reported basis and underneath that and it's got ties to the next, the next six months and I think actually the next three years is the quality of growth.
segments.zh: 报告基础上增长了10%，而在这背后，与接下来的六个月，实际上我认为是未来三年相关的是增长的质量。

segments.en: Uh, we've got differentiated innovation. That's the story about Elanco and major markets. We believe this is best medicine and we're winning in the largest biggest, uh,
segments.zh: 我们有差异化的创新，这就是Elanco在主要市场的故事。我们相信这是最好的药物，我们正在最大的动物健康市场中获胜，包括Durham、寄生虫药、牛等各个领域。

segments.en: uh, markets in animal health with Durham, parasiticides, cattle across the board. And that was represented. We had 11% growth in US pet health, 11% farm animal,
segments.zh: 这体现在美国宠物健康增长11%，农场动物增长11%，国际宠物健康增长9%，我们的牛业务全球增长17%。

segments.en: and 9% international pet health in our cattle business, uh, globally grew 17%. So look, we've got the right portfolio, the right innovation and we've set the company up with this omnichannel being able to reach this pet owner.
segments.zh: 所以你看，我们拥有正确的组合，正确的创新，并且我们通过全渠道能够触达宠物主人。

segments.en: So if I look, you know, we guided and we raised our guide for the rest of the year, it'll be driven by all all segments growing international US pet and farm price and volume. We see accelerated price remain because we do see a pet owner that is really, really determined when it comes to pet health that they have a higher expectation of care that you and I've talked about.
segments.zh: 所以，我们给出了指引并上调了今年剩余时间的指引，这将由所有细分市场的增长驱动，包括国际、美国宠物和农场动物的价格和数量。我们看到价格加速上涨，因为我们确实看到宠物主人在宠物健康方面非常坚定，他们对护理有更高的期望，这是我们之前谈过的。
